scope: Network-asset OS identity and hardware sensor sources only; common interface collection is not changed.
notes: MIB files are copied byte-for-byte from the pinned LibreNMS commit; upstream paths and SHA-256 are recorded per file.
MIBs are grouped under the asset vendor scope for offline indexing. Standard MIB definitions are grouped under mibs/standard/.
This is a curated source bundle for hardware polling. It is not a full LibreNMS checkout or a complete all-vendor MIB archive.
The upstream LibreNMS OS discovery YAML files are retained unchanged and are covered by their upstream license.
